en.title: Travel desk
en.scope: Check dated fictional Beijing lodging rules and your own example order. Answers quote a small local source collection; they are not real travel policy.
en.question: Your policy question
en.question_help: Try “Beijing lodging”. For the example order, choose “Read A-104”.
en.handoff: Prepare a note for a person
en.handoff_boundary: The note stays on this screen. Copy it yourself for a policy owner. This service does not send messages or cancel orders.
en.privacy: Feedback stores a problem category and request reference for local review, for at most seven days. It does not automatically change answers. Closing the demo clears in-memory requests and feedback.
en.no_script: This demo needs JavaScript for requests. The textbook contains the full static examples and results.
en.answered: Answer ready. Read the source and its date before using it.
en.abstained: I could not find enough supporting evidence in this collection. Try a more specific policy question or ask a policy owner.
en.refused: This record is unavailable to this demo account. No order was changed.
en.error: The request could not finish. No order was changed. You can try again or prepare a note for a person.
en.cancelled: Request stopped. No order was changed.
en.already_finished: The request finished before it could be stopped. Clear the view if you no longer need it.
en.rate_limited: Too many recent requests. Wait a moment before trying again.
en.overloaded: The service is busy. Wait a moment before trying again.
en.connection_unknown: The connection was interrupted. The request may still be running; no order can be changed by this service.
en.cleared: View cleared. You can undo this change.
en.restored: Previous view restored. This does not change a server request or order.
en.handoff_text: Please check the applicable policy for this question and date:
en.feedback_saved: Report saved for local review. It has not changed the sources or answers.
en.order_as_of: Fictional snapshot, not a live merchant record

zh-hans.title: 差旅资料助手
zh-hans.scope: 查询指定日期适用的虚构北京住宿制度，以及本人名下的示例订单。答案摘自一小份本地资料，不是真实差旅制度。
zh-hans.question: 想查哪项制度
zh-hans.question_help: 可以输入“北京住宿”。查询示例订单，请选择“查看 A-104”。
zh-hans.handoff_boundary: 说明只留在当前页面。请自行复制给制度负责人。本服务不会发送消息，也不会取消订单。
zh-hans.privacy: 反馈只保存问题类别和请求编号，供本地审核，最多保留七天；不会自动修改答案。关闭演示服务后，内存中的请求与反馈会清空。
zh-hans.no_script: 演示程序需要 JavaScript 才能发起请求。教材正文已经完整展示静态例题与结果。
zh-hans.answered: 答案已生成，请先核对来源及其适用日期。
zh-hans.abstained: 这份资料库中没有足够的依据。可以把制度问题写得更具体，或请制度负责人核对。
zh-hans.refused: 当前演示账户无法查看这条记录。没有修改任何订单。
zh-hans.error: 这次请求未能完成，没有修改任何订单。可以稍后重试，或准备一份说明交给人工核对。
zh-hans.cancelled: 请求已停止，没有修改任何订单。
zh-hans.already_finished: 请求已经完成，未能停止。如果不再需要，可以清空当前页面内容。
zh-hans.rate_limited: 刚才的请求较多，请稍等片刻再试。
zh-hans.overloaded: 服务正忙，请稍等片刻再试。
zh-hans.connection_unknown: 连接已中断，请求可能还在处理。本服务没有修改订单的能力。
zh-hans.cleared: 当前页面内容已清空，可以撤销。
zh-hans.restored: 已恢复刚才的页面内容。这不会改变服务端请求或订单。
zh-hans.handoff_text: 请核对以下问题在指定日期适用的制度：
zh-hans.feedback_saved: 已保存，等待本地审核。资料和答案尚未因此改变。
zh-hans.order_as_of: 虚构资料快照，不是商家的实时记录
